aboutGame.title: What is Japanese Ramen Simulator?
paragraphs: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a first-person cooking and management game for PC, published on Steam in Early Access by Wild Dog. You run a small ramen shop from the kitchen up: source ingredients, simmer broth, marinate eggs, portion toppings, boil noodles to order, and hand steaming bowls to a growing line of customers.

Between services you reinvest your earnings into the business side of the shop, adding burners and storage to raise throughput, seating and staff to serve more guests, and new recipes that lift each bowl's price. The real challenge is resource management: every pot of broth and every noodle you boil costs money and time you never get back, so planning beats raw speed.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Japanese Ramen Simulator.

items.question: What is Japanese Ramen Simulator?
items.answer: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a first-person cooking and management game for PC on Steam, published in Early Access by Wild Dog. You source ingredients, simmer broth, boil noodles to order, plate toppings, and serve customers while reinvesting your profits into a bigger, faster shop.

items.question: Is Japanese Ramen Simulator hard for beginners?
items.answer: The first few in-game days are demanding because the game rarely pauses to explain itself, but the systems are learnable quickly. Prep broth and toppings before opening, serve a small menu well, and bank your early profits before upgrading anything.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Japanese Ramen Simulator?
items.answer: Throughput first. Extra burners or cooking stations directly increase how many bowls you serve per hour, and refrigeration cuts spoilage waste. Seating and staff help once the kitchen keeps pace, and decor comes last.

items.question: Does Japanese Ramen Simulator have multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. Japanese Ramen Simulator multiplayer puts several players in one shared kitchen, where a clean split of broth, noodle, topping, and front-of-house duties out-serves a team all crowding the same pot.

items.question: How do I make money fast in Japanese Ramen Simulator?
items.answer: Sell a tight menu of high-margin bowls and side items, price around 2.5 to 3 times ingredient cost, serve quickly, and skip any upgrade that does not raise your output. Margin beats raw volume in the opening hours.
